title: RANGER: Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.28010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning offers a promising direction for complex sequential decision-making tasks, such as multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. While LLMs provide strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, they often struggle with precise, multi-step navigation in structured environments. Conversely, RL agents excel at learning navigation policies but are hindered by the difficulty of designing semantically meaningful reward functions. This paper introduces a novel hybrid approach in which an LLM serves as a mentor to an RL agent during training by providing dense, semantically informed reward signals. The RL agent, built on a Transformer-based policy and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization, learns to navigate a knowledge graph to retrieve relevant information. translated_title: RANGER：基于语义评估奖励的图导航检索智能体
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型与强化学习的结合为复杂的序列决策任务（如知识图谱上的多跳问答）提供了一个有前景的方向。虽然大型语言模型具有强大的语义理解和推理能力，但它们在结构化环境中的精确多步导航方面往往存在困难。相反，强化学习智能体擅长学习导航策略，但语义上有意义的奖励函数设计困难阻碍了其发展。本文提出了一种新颖的混合方法，在训练过程中，大型语言模型作为强化学习智能体的导师，提供密集的、语义信息丰富的奖励信号。该强化学习智能体基于Transformer策略构建，并通过组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）进行训练，学习在知识图谱中导航以检索相关信息。大型语言模型评估智能体所遍历路径的语义相关性，并生成奖励信号……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RANGER混合框架，让大型语言模型在训练中充当导师，为强化学习智能体提供密集的语义奖励信号，使其学会在知识图谱上导航并完成多跳问答任务。
en_tdlr: RANGER is a hybrid framework where an LLM acts as a mentor providing dense, semantically informed reward signals to train a Transformer-based RL agent (via GRPO) that learns to navigate knowledge graphs for multi-hop question answering.
